errors.text_span: with tick labels spaced at intervals of 100
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, and 1000, indicating intervals of 200, not 100.
The y-axis scale clearly extends from 0 to 400 GB, not starting from 150 GB.

errors.text_span: shows a rapid decrease from a value of approximately 380 GB at 0 frames to approximately 230 GB at 400 frames
errors.evidence: The red/pink line (VideoLLaMB) is one of the lowest on the graph, starting near 10-15 GB and increasing very slowly. The description of a rapid decrease from a high value is a complete hallucination.
All lines in the plot use circular markers, not square ones.

errors.text_span: increases from a value of approximately 75 GB at 0 frames to approximately 100 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: The dark orange/brown line (VideoLLaMB-R) actually increases from about 10-15 GB at 0 frames to about 35-40 GB at 1000 frames. The stated values are significantly incorrect.

errors.text_span: starts at approximately 65 GB at 0 frames and increases to approximately 95 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: No line on the chart matches this description. The teal line (LLaVA-NeXT) starts at ~15 GB and ends at ~140 GB. The green line (PLLaVA) starts at ~15 GB and ends at ~75 GB. The described values are incorrect.

errors.text_span: begins at approximately 40 GB at 0 frames and rises to approximately 80 GB at 1000 frames
errors.evidence: No line on the chart matches this description. The light blue/teal line (LLaVA-NeXT) starts near 15 GB and ends near 140 GB. The green line (PLLaVA) ends around 75 GB but starts near 15 GB, not 40 GB. The values are incorrect.

errors.text_span: begins near 300 GB at 0 frames and decreases to approximately 350 GB at 400 frames
errors.evidence: The purple line (VideoLLAVA) starts at a low memory value (~15 GB) and increases exponentially, going off the top of the chart before 300 frames. The description states the complete opposite trend and hallucinates incorrect values.
The description identifies the lines only by color and fails to mention the model names (e.g., VideoLLaMB, PLLaVA, VideoLLAVA) associated with each line as indicated in the legend.
